name: Kotonoha Decadence
source:
It was such a wild trip.

Immediately after graduating from high school, all my classmates travel together on their own terms.
That alone... well, that's hard enough.
Seven days after the revelation of the plan.
We had already finished our three-night, four-day trip and had returned to Tokyo.

We won't forget.
Dear, hateful, most powerful classmates.

Some edges are cut off, and others continue.
The two next to me.
The bond between him and her will continue.

But what awaited me when I got home was -- further parting.


A year and four months have passed since then.

The days taken away never come back.
But with my friends and new family, my pain is buried in my daily life.
It's probably a happy and very unfortunate thing at the same time.

But -- the gears that have gone mad by the many ivy lines that are entangled in them will surely eat away at their daily lives.
Reality creaks and the world is distorted.
An unwanted door opens its jaw.

The first day of my life was tinged with vermilion -- the false rest now came to an end.

[Translated from the [url=http://home.freelance.ne.jp/~nino/slow/index2.html#story]official website[/url]]
